unified_contract.login_success: auth_complete === true and session_token is a non-empty string

frontend_flow_after_fix: Login form submits one request only.
Login form redirects immediately to dashboard or force-password-reset.
/auth/me runs only as supplemental background hydration.
Capability, permission, module, approval, and user data load lazily after auth state is established.

login_page_behavior.change: Login page is wrapped in PublicOnly.
login_page_behavior.effect: If a session token already exists, /login redirects to the authenticated destination instead of rendering a login form or clearing state.

public_only_behavior.unauthenticated_or_checking: Render public children without clearing auth storage.

error_handling.401_from_background_fetch: does not clear token-backed auth state
